title: Whether father read music; Sidney arranged
summary: Father likely read music; brother Sidney arranged and wrote music at home.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Do you think your father ever wrote any music or, you know, did he ever have any formal training in the, some drummers, a lot of drummers are able to play, of course, without ever learning to read music. I mean, just sort of make up the parts that he ever, uh, I think my daddy read music.

He probably would. He used to read music. But I don't know of him arranging anything. But my brother arranged music and wrote music. My brother Sidney, the one who played sax, he wrote music. And you see, I was old enough when he died, got killed to remember those things. I remember seeing him sitting down and arranging music. Yeah. Yeah, he used to sit down and arrange music and write it. Yeah, he was pretty good, my brother Sidney was. But I don't remember too much about my daddy doing that, because you see, he had that business. And in the daytime he was at that business where he'd take a rest over there, he had a little room in his shop where he used to rest on the day when he was running his bed. Then at night he'd go play music, you see. So we didn't see too much of my daddy around the house, because he had a business and he played music, you see. But my brother, well he went down, but at night he was home, the nights he didn't play music, he was sitting there writing it or arranging music or something, he was pretty good at it.
